title: Rao Bahadur
plot_overview: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world within its walls. As reality and imagination increasingly overlap, his secluded existence becomes difficult to understand, leaving him caught between the world he inhabits and the one he has constructed.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like eerie psychological dramas, isolated settings, and stories that blur reality and imagination; Not for you if you prefer straightforward plots or lighter entertainment.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing psychological premise; gothic atmosphere; surreal uncertainty | Cons: potentially slow-paced; emotionally bleak; deliberately ambiguous
